method: Same undeformed physical coordinates and explicit element/body/material sides in both retained affine C3D10 meshes. Quadratic displacement; tensor interpolation precedes invariants, with the declared unaveraged/partitioned-smoothed mode. Changes are compared minus reference; relative change is absolute change / absolute reference, unavailable at or below the disclosed SI reference floor. Floors are display conventions, not numerical acceptance tolerances. Raw native extrema are separate moving locations. One arbitrary comparison cannot establish convergence, accuracy, stability or safety.

warnings: Connectivity and rigid-motion support checks are necessary only, not proof of stiffness rank or stability; no weak springs are added.

assumptions.message: Peaks near supports, reentrant corners or idealized load/bond edges may increase with refinement. No automatic singularity detection is claimed. Compare fixed physical locations away from these regions; a lower smoothed peak is not evidence of convergence or a design allowable.
